```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```


## Descriptive analyses
### Raw dataset

```{r}
pd <- readRDS(here("data", "ProjectData_2324.rds"))
summary(pd)
```

```{r}
sum(duplicated(pd))
```


```{r}
# check if all variables exist
var <- c("Demqol_staff", "visit", "agecat", "marital3cat", "npi_symptoms_0", "chc_04")
pd_demqol <- pd$Demqol_staff 
pd_visit <- pd$visit
pd_agecat <- pd$agecat
pd_marital <- pd$marital3cat
pd_symptoms <- pd$npi_symptoms_0
pd_dementia <- pd$chc_04
summary(pd_demqol)
summary(pd_visit)
summary(pd_agecat)
summary(pd_marital)
summary(pd_symptoms)
summary(pd_dementia)
```


```{r}
summary(pd_demqol)
length(pd_demqol)
sum(is.na(pd_demqol))
boxplot(pd_demqol)
hist(pd_demqol)
ggplot(data.frame(x = pd_demqol), aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 15,
                 fill = "grey85", colour = "white") +
  geom_density(bw = "SJ", colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1)
```

### Checking for impact of variable addition on the NAs

```{r}
var1 <- c("Demqol_staff", "visit")
pd_select1 <- pd[var1]
pd_clean1 <- drop_na(pd_select1)
summary(pd_clean1)

```



### Complete case analysis

```{r}
pd_select <- pd[var]
pd_clean <- drop_na(pd_select)
summary(pd_clean)
```


```{r}
pd_clean_demqol <- pd_clean$Demqol_staff
pd_clean_visit <- pd_clean$visit
pd_clean_agecat <- pd_clean$agecat
pd_clean_marital <- pd_clean$marital3cat
pd_clean_symptoms <- pd_clean$npi_symptoms_0
pd_clean_dementia <- pd_clean$chc_04
```

### Version with factor

```{r}
# Dataset version with ordinal/categorical data converted into factors
pd_copy <- pd_clean
pd_copy$chc_04 <- as.factor(pd_clean$chc_04)
pd_copy$marital3cat <- as.factor(pd_clean$marital3cat)
pd_copy$agecat <- as.factor(pd_clean$agecat)
pd_copy$visit <- as.factor(pd_clean$visit)
```



```{r}
summary(pd_clean_demqol)
length(pd_clean_demqol)
sum(is.na(pd_clean_demqol))
boxplot(pd_clean_demqol)
hist(pd_clean_demqol)
ggplot(data.frame(x = pd_clean_demqol), aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 10,
                 fill = "grey85", colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_density(bw = "SJ", colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1)
```
